what: Two builds of the 6 modules of lean/Research/CographDist/ from new empty output directories, one after the other, on the author's Mac (Apple silicon), with the pinned toolchain and Mathlib (not rebuilt).
commands: per build: lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false on each module in import order, then leanchecker on each module; 12 commands per build, 24 in all, every one exit code 0 at the first attempt
diagnostics: no error, no warning, no sorry in any log; leanchecker prints nothing on success
olean: the 6 .olean files of the two builds are byte for byte identical (olean-sha256.txt in each log archive)
axioms: Research.CographDist.Audit prints 7 axiom lists (check_OpenProblemI_negative, check_family and the five tests), each exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
script: tworoots.sh (Claude); not published, the logs record each command's result
logs_note: Local paths replaced by <workspace>, <project>, <home>; nothing else changed.
